text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to the movie theater—
I spotted Mejiro Ryan looking all around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh.
I wonder if McQueen is here yet~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahyaaaaah!?
T-Trainer-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From Mejiro Ryan's trembling hand,
the movie ticket stub slipped and fell. Rushing to pick it up—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah! W-Wait, that's...!
choice_data_list: 'The Pony Girl and the Wolf Prince'...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, it was supposed to be
a live-action adaptation of a famous shojo manga...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Waaah!
U-Um, well, you see...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Apparently McQueen's a fan of this director,
so I came along with her—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I'm late!
My errand took a little longer than expected...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You've been looking forward to this so much you read the original manga over and over, haven't you? Come, let us make haste!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, McQueen~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "—A-Anyway! Apparently it's a very serious, artistic, and deeply educational work!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
Let's just leave it at that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
See?!
McQueen is saying so too...!
choice_data_list: In that case, maybe I'll watch it too.
In that case, maybe I'll watch it too.
Isn't it about to start already?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
See?!
McQueen is saying so too...!
choice_data_list: In that case, maybe I'll watch it too.
In that case, maybe I'll watch it too.
Isn't it about to start already?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Ah, um, that is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Ryan.
It might be best not to make clumsy excuses right now..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: N-No wayyy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan's Trainer. Have some mercy,
and please seat them far apart...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Mejiro McQueen's words,
I decided to watch the movie from a seat away from the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-Woooow...!
That was truly stoic, artistic, and so educational...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right!
See, McQueen too...! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, of course!
Um, likeâthat confession scene at the end!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
YES YES YES YES!!
That confession was the absolute beeeeeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I'll never let you go."
With those words, our lips cl—came closer, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That was super heart-pounding—I mean,
super informative. Yep!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To protect Mejiro Ryan's honor, I vowed to never speak of this matter again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Y-You're right...!
I have to hurry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank goodness.
Looks like I managed to play it off somehow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, yeah. If that's how Ryan
feels about it, then I guess that's fine."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just as I came out of the theater
after watching a different movie—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: T-That was suuuuuper amazing! Especially that confession near the end!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
U-Understood.
So please calm yourself, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "And then... um! Th-Th-The k-k-k-kiss scene... gah!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, while I was busy calming you down
as you writhed in agony, I ended up missing it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hawawawawawa...! Wh-What should I do~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan! Let's get out of here!
Before your Trainer gets back...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right.
It'd be awful if someone saw us like this...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Then let's grab some tea
and talk about it thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Make sure to bring me back before dorm curfew, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching the two walk away, I vowed to myself never to bring up this matter again.
